resources.string: Your phone online through your computer
Activate Shiho here, or let Shiho on your computer do it for you.
Your network keeps working as normal until your computer connects.
Turn on USB debugging in Developer options, and plug this phone into your computer.
On the computer, open Shiho in Chrome. Get it from %1$s.
Pick this phone and choose Share this computer\'s network. Every app, Minori\'s machines and the Terminal get online.
Android needs your OK before Shiho can act as a VPN.
Shiho was turned off because another VPN took over, or it was turned off in Settings.
Another VPN has taken over. Open Shiho on the phone and activate it again.
Another app is using Shiho\'s connection name. Restart the phone and try again.
